en: A sepia-toned historical postcard showing a dense street procession of French soldiers and musicians marching through a crowded city street lined with traditional half-timbered houses. Flags hang from the buildings and large crowds celebrate on both sides of the street. The scene depicts the ceremonial entry of Marshal Pétain into Strasbourg on 25 November 1918, shortly after World War I.
